python3 -c "
target='((..(((((........(.((..((.(.....(....).((((((((.........((......((((.....))))......))...((..((.......(..(......)..)..((..((.....((....)).((((.....(((.....(..((.(...).))..).....))).((((...(.......(..(.((...)).)..).......)...))))........)))).....((((((...)))))).))..))...........))..)).........(..((((....))((((((.....(........).....))))))..))..)...))))))))........).))..)).).....(.......).)))))..)).'
print(len(target))
stack=[]
pairs={}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i
        pairs[i]=j
import collections
# build sequence: paired -> alternating GC/CG by stem, unpaired -> A (loops rich in A, but allow some U for tetraloops like GNRA)
seq=['A']*len(target)
# Assign pairs: walk pairs, group by adjacency
# Simple: for each pair use G-C if index even else C-G, with occasional A-U to break symmetry
assigned=set()
# Group adjacent pairs into stems
visited=set()
stems=[]
for i in range(len(target)):
    if i in pairs and i not in visited:
        j=pairs[i]
        if i<j:
            # collect stem
            stem=[]
            a,b=i,j
            while a in pairs and b in pairs and pairs[a]==b and a<b and a not in visited:
                stem.append((a,b)); visited.add(a); visited.add(b)
                a+=1; b-=1
            stems.append(stem)
for s in stems:
    for k,(a,b) in enumerate(s):
        # alternate
        if k%2==0:
            seq[a]='G'; seq[b]='C'
        else:
            seq[a]='C'; seq[b]='G'
# Make some 4-loops GNRA-like and 3-loops stable
# Leave loops as A for now
print(''.join(seq))
"
